turns.text: Um, hi, I, uh, I made a booking an hour ago, and I, I booked the wrong day. Sorry.
No worries, I can help. May I have your booking code and last name?
Yes, it's HN2W9Q, Fischer. Lena Fischer.
Thank you, Ms. Fischer. I see SK510 to Mumbai on Wednesday at 07:45. What would you like instead?
I, uh, I want the, the Friday one, at 21:00. SK512. Can I, can that be free? Or a refund?
Since you booked less than 24 hours ago, the change is free. SK512 is 190 dollars, lower than your 210, so there's no fare difference. Shall I book Friday at 21:00?
Oh, really? Um, yes, please. Wait, will I get the difference back? Sorry.
I can't promise any money back on the difference. I can move you to Friday at 21:00 with no fee. Would you like that?
Okay, yes, that's, that's fine. Thank you so much.
Done. You're now on SK512 to Mumbai on Friday at 21:00 with no fee. Anything else?
No, no, that's everything, I, I think. Thank you!
You're welcome. To sum up, I changed your booking to SK512 on Friday at 21:00 at no charge.
